rocket-game.title: Rocket Game: Thrilling Space Adventure
rocket-game.slogan: Pilot your rocket through challenging levels and soar towards the stars!
rocket-game.description: Rocket Game pushes you into an exciting adventure! Pilot your rocket through challenging levels and avoid obstacles as you soar towards the stars. This physics-based driving game offers unique experiences traveling through dangerous roads. Immerse yourself in these unique experiences to make your leisure time more exciting. Play Rocket Game now and enjoy the thrill!

HomeIframe.title: Rocket Game: Thrilling Space Adventure
HomeIframe.description: Pilot your rocket through challenging levels and avoid obstacles as you soar towards the stars. Enjoy unique experiences traveling through dangerous roads.

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Rocket Game is a physics-based driving game with experiences traveling through dangerous roads. Steep slopes and bumpy hills will make your journey even more spectacular.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: UP arrow: go straight; press and hold to accelerate.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: DOWN arrow: going backwards, usually to gain momentum.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: SPACEBAR: rocket mode, press and hold to adjust the 'firing' force for this special vehicle.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Navigate through complex platforms and overcome obstacles.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Experience realistic physics as you drive through dangerous roads.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Use rocket mode to make momentum jumps and shoot away like a rocket.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Immerse yourself in unique experiences that make the game addictive.
